About us

UCS was established by Joy Chowdhury in New York City, USA, with the view to offering transparent and seamless advice and options to those wishing to study abroad. Our head office in Queens, New York City, includes a strong team of professionals led by our CEO. Our friendly staff is available 24/7 to enable students to explore their options in their chosen country at any time. Our team specializes in studying abroad in the USA and Canada and has a wide variety of options available to students and their families. We offer options for both higher education and secondary education in both the USA and Canada and have options for all budgets, enabling students to focus on their dream destination and their career path. The international reach of our CEO’s diverse network means our agency can offer recruitment expertise in various nations whilst recruiting a diverse mixture of international students from a long list of countries. It also allows us to pursue closer relationships and better knowledge of the institutions our students choose to attend.
